fields.text: Tips & Tricks
You can publish your bullets on a website (that's right, this website is made with TreeWrite!). The website and the editor have the same look and feel
Everything is a bullet, and there are many bullet types (text, code, image, checkbox, ...)
All bullets are stored in a single `.jsonl` file on your computer, no cloud storage (ever). You own your data in an open and documented file format
You can search globally, filter by tags or by calendar
Learn more about how TreeWrite works
**Convinced?** [Install TreeWrite](https://google.com) and start organizing your bullets
